details_i18n.en: Treat the temple conclusion as linked fights and save consumable medicines for the harder final section. When Yellowbrow's body turns gold, stop relying on light attacks: create space, charge a heavy strike and repeat if the coating remains. Attack after the coating breaks. details_i18n.pt: Trate o encerramento do templo como lutas interligadas e guarde remédios consumíveis para o trecho final mais difícil.
